greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Maanta, markaan u dabaaldegayno Iidda Kor-u-qaadista Saliibka Quduuska ah, waxaan eegaynaa wax u muuqda mid liddi ku ah caqliga bini'aadamka. Waxaan eegaynaa qoryo qallalan oo la is-dhaafiyay, waxaan eegaynaa xanuun iyo dhimasho, haddana waxaan ku arkaynaa halkaas fursad nolol weligeed ah. Bal qiyaas, saaxiibbadaa, qof si taxaddar leh u dhisaya diyaarad yar oo uu ugu magac daray 'Con Chim Airlines'. Waxaan ognahay in Benjamin Vo uu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo dhisayo waxyaabo waaweyn, isagoo isticmaalaya maskaxdiisa fiiqan ee xisaabta iyo tiknoolajiyadda. Laakiin maanta, waxaan ka hadlaynaa aasaas ka duwan kii uu Ben ku dhisayay diyaaradihiisa. Waxaan ka hadlaynaa aasaaska Saliibka.

Akhriska koowaad wuxuu inoo sheegayaa dadkii reer binu Israa'iil oo ka cabanaya Rabbiga. Waxay dareemeen daal, waxay dareemeen oomman, waxayna bilaabeen inay eedeeyaan Ilaah. Waxay ahayd xaalad ay ka buuxdo cabsi iyo xanuun. Markaasuu Rabbigu amray Muuse inuu sameeyo abeeso naxaas ah oo uu kor u qaado. Qofkii eega abeesadaas, wuu noolaanayaa. Maxay tani ka dhigan tahay? Saliibku wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in xanuunka aan laga dhuuman karin, laakiin loo baahan yahay in la eego. 

Alan iyo Thao, saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale. Waxaan ogahay in xanuunkaani uu yahay mid culus. Waxaan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemaysaan inuu adduunku idinla dhacay, sida dadkii reer binu Israa'iil oo kale. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, ee aad u sheegi jirtay sheekooyinka aad ku qosli jirteen, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. 

Bal eega Saliibka. Ciise wuxuu u dhimatay si uu u qaado xanuunkeenna. Saliibku waa calaamadda jacaylka Ilaah ee aan xadka lahayn. Sida Ben oo kale, oo ahaa wiil qalbigiisu u furnaa inuu wax walba bixiyo—xusuusnow markuu rabay inuu siiyo lacagta sanduuqiisa yar adeerkiis William? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbiyada Masiixa oo kale. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in. Sii wad inaad riyooto, sii wad inaad noolaato, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay. 

Saliibku ma aha dhamaadka. Saliibku waa dariiqa loo maro sarakicidda. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa gacmaha Rabbiga, isagoo ka xor ah xanuun kasta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maaddaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata, fadlan igu soo gal naftayda si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu qaadanayaa sidii inaad hore u joogtay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga gebi ahaanba. Waligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbiga ha inoo barakeeyo, ha inoo ilaaliyo, oo ha inoo tusiyo wajigiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah oo uu ku soo dhoweeyo iftiinkiisa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo nabad, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Dadkii markay safarka daaleen, waxay ka cawdeen Ilaah iyo Muuse, waxayna yidhaahdeen, 'Maxaad Masar nooga soo saarteen inaan halkan cidlada ku dhimanno? Halkan ma jiro cunto iyo biyo toona, cunnadan xun ayaannu ka caajisnay.' Markaasuu Rabbigu dadkii u soo diray abeesooyin sun ah, oo dad badan baa dhintay. Markaasay dadkii u yimaadeen Muuse oo ku yidhaahdeen, 'Waanu dembaabnay markaan ka cawnay Rabbiga iyo adigaba. Rabbiga u bari inuu abeesooyinka naga fogeeyo.' Muuse baa dadkii u baryay, Rabbiguna wuxuu ku yidhi Muuse, 'Samee abeeso naxaas ah, oo kor u qaad tiir, qofkii la qaniino oo eega abeesadaas, wuu noolaanayaa.' Muuse wuxuu sameeyay abeeso naxaas ah, wuxuuna kor u qaaday tiir, qofkii la qaniino oo eega abeesadaas, wuu noolaanayaa.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Ha illoobin shuqullada Rabbiga! Dadkaygiiyow, dhegaysta sharcigayga, dhegaha u dhiga ereyada afkayga. Waxaan afkayga u furayaa masaal, waxaan ku hadlayaa waxyaalo qarsoon oo hore. Markuu dilayay, way dooneen, wayna u soo noqdeen Ilaah, iyagoo xusuusan in Ilaah yahay dhagaxooda iyo Rabbiga ugu sarreeya, kooda badbaadiya. Laakiin waxay ku maamuuseen afkooda, waxayna been ugu sheegeen carrabkooda, qalbigooduna kuma uu adkayn isaga, mana aysan aaminin axdigiisa. Laakiin isagu, isagoo naxariis badan, wuu u cafiyay dembigooda, mana uu baabbi'in; marar badan ayuu cadhadiisii dib u celiyay, mana uu oggolaan in cadhadiisu kacdo. R. Ha illoobin shuqullada Rabbiga!

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Ciise Masiix, in kastoo uu ahaa qaabka Ilaah, uma uu arkin sinnaanta Ilaah wax la qabsado. Hase yeeshee, wuu is-madhiyay, isagoo qaatay qaabka addoon, isagoo yimid qaabka bini'aadamka; oo markii la helay isagoo bini'aadam ah, wuu is-hoosaysiiyay, isagoo noqday mid addeecsan ilaa dhimashada, xataa dhimashada saliibka. Sababtaas daraaddeed, Ilaah aad buu u sarraysiiyay, wuxuuna siiyay magac ka sarreeya magac kasta, si magaca Ciise jilib kasta u foorarsado, kuwa jannada iyo kuwa dhulka iyo kuwa dhulka hoostiisa, oo carrab kastana uu u qirto in Ciise Masiix yahay Rabbiga, ammaanta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi Nikodemos, 'Ma jiro qof jannada kor u kacay, midkii jannada ka soo degay mooyaane, kan ah Wiilka Bini'aadamka. Sida Muuse u kor u qaaday abeesadii cidlada, sidaas oo kale waa in Wiilka Bini'aadamka kor loo qaadaa, si qof kasta oo rumeeya uu u helo nolol weligeed ah. Waayo Ilaah aad buu u jeclaaday dunida, wuxuuna bixiyay Wiilkiisa keliya, si qof kasta oo rumeeya uusan u baabbi'in, laakiin uu u helo nolol weligeed ah. Waayo Ilaah uma uu soo dirin Wiilkiisa dunida inuu dunida xukumo, laakiin in dunida lagu badbaadiyo isaga.'

day: Feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school
